We're running quick research sessions to understand how you work and what would make your n8n experience better.

What's involved:
• A 30-minute video chat (recorded for internal notes)
• Screen share to show us around your n8n instance
• $50 gift card as a thank you
• The interview will be conducted in English

Interested?
Pick a time that works for you: {{calendly_link}}

Thank you!

parameters.content:
## UXR Config
Centralized configuration for the **UXR Recruiting** tool. Called as a sub-workflow to load limits, email template, quality gates, filter definitions, cooldown and shard settings.

**SAFETY SWITCH: `liveMode` (boolean).** While it is `false` (or missing), UXR Send & Stamp rewrites EVERY recipient to `testRecipient`, caps the batch at `testMaxRecipients` and writes nothing to Customer.io. Set to `true` for production and real sends.

**Cooldown.** The main tool is Customer.io segment **260** ("User Research - 60 Day Cooldown"): anyone invited to research in the last 60 days, by the wizard or by a broadcast. UXR Search excludes its members server-side, so they never appear in a sample.

`cooldownDays` (60) is the safety net on our side: Search drops profiles stamped in the last 60 days, Send & Stamp skips emails already sent or booked in the last 60 days (Candidates table). It covers segment refresh lag and sends that never got stamped. Keep it equal to the segment window.

`calendlyUtmSource` is read by the Handler (utm_source on the booking link) and by UXR Calendly Booking (webhook filter): change it in one place only.

**Do not execute directly.**
